title: THE SHOCKING TRUTH ABOUT THE WEEDS AMONG US—JESUS WARNED US ALL!
paragraphs: THE SHOCKING TRUTH ABOUT THE WEEDS AMONG US—JESUS WARNED US ALL!

A WARNING YOU CANNOT IGNORE!
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what did Jesus mean when He said the enemy planted weeds among the wheat? Does this mean there are fake Christians in the church?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people believe that everyone who calls themselves a Christian is truly saved—but Jesus destroyed that false idea with the Parable of the Weeds (Tares).
🚨 THE SHOCKING TRUTH: NOT EVERYONE WHO CLAIMS TO FOLLOW JESUS ACTUALLY BELONGS TO HIM!

📖 Matthew 13:24-25 (KJV)
"The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way."

🔥 TODAY, WE WILL UNCOVER:
✔️ The hidden truth behind this parable—what Jesus was REALLY warning us about
✔️ How Satan plants FAKE believers in the church to spread deception
✔️ What will happen to the weeds (false Christians) on Judgment Day
🚨 The truth may shock you—but you cannot ignore it!

THE TRUTH REVEALED – WHAT DID JESUS REALLY MEAN?
📖 Matthew 13:24-30 (KJV)
"Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way. But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also. So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares? He said unto them, An enemy hath done this..."

🔥 WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?
At first, this might seem like just an agricultural story, but Jesus was revealing a deep spiritual truth—Satan is secretly planting counterfeit believers inside the church!

✅ 1. THE WHEAT REPRESENTS TRUE BELIEVERS—THE WEEDS REPRESENT FALSE CHRISTIANS!
The field is the world, and God plants true believers (wheat) in His kingdom. But Satan sneaks in at night and plants fake believers (tares/weeds) to deceive and destroy.

📖 Matthew 13:38-39 (KJV)
"The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one; The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Not everyone who attends church is truly saved!
✔️ Some people claim to follow Jesus but are actually Satan’s plants!
✔️ True believers and fake believers grow together—until Judgment Day!
🚨 THE WARNING: The church is full of people who LOOK like Christians—but are actually weeds in disguise!
💡 QUESTION: Are you wheat or a weed? Does your life produce real fruit, or are you just pretending?

✅ 2. SATAN PLANTS COUNTERFEIT CHRISTIANS TO DECEIVE OTHERS!
Jesus made it clear that the enemy (Satan) is the one who plants weeds in the church!

📖 2 Corinthians 11:13-14 (KJV)
"For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ. And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Satan doesn’t just attack from outside—he infiltrates the church from within!
✔️ There are pastors, teachers, and church leaders who LOOK godly but are actually working for the devil!
✔️ Satan’s greatest weapon is deception—he doesn’t remove Christianity, he COUNTERFEITS it!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you think the enemy is only outside the church, you’re already deceived!
💡 QUESTION: Are you following real biblical truth, or have you been influenced by a counterfeit gospel?

✅ 3. THE WHEAT AND THE WEEDS LOOK THE SAME—UNTIL THE HARVEST!
One of the most terrifying facts about this parable is that wheat and tares look IDENTICAL until it’s time for harvest.

📖 Matthew 7:16 (KJV)
"Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?"

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Fake Christians can fool people—but they cannot fool Jesus!
✔️ On the outside, they may look holy, but their FRUIT exposes them!
✔️ The only way to tell the difference is by examining the results of their life!
🚨 THE WARNING: Not everyone who calls Jesus "Lord" truly belongs to Him!
💡 QUESTION: If Jesus inspected your life right now, what fruit would He find?

✅ 4. GOD ALLOWS THE WHEAT AND WEEDS TO GROW TOGETHER—FOR NOW!
📖 Matthew 13:29-30 (KJV)
"But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them. Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ God is allowing false believers to remain for a season—but their judgment is coming!
✔️ This is why there is corruption in churches—because weeds are mixed in with the wheat!
✔️ God is waiting for the final harvest, when He will separate the real from the fake!
🚨 THE WARNING: Just because someone "looks" saved now doesn’t mean they will be spared from judgment later!
💡 QUESTION: Are you ready for the final harvest, or will you be burned with the weeds?

✅ 5. MANY WILL BE SHOCKED ON JUDGMENT DAY WHEN JESUS REJECTS THEM!
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 (KJV)
"Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven. Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Many people THINK they are Christians—but Jesus will reject them!
✔️ Religious works mean nothing without true obedience to God!
✔️ "Christians" who live in sin are actually weeds in disguise!
🚨 THE WARNING: Being "Christian" in name only will not save you—your life must prove it!
💡 QUESTION: Would Jesus recognize you as wheat, or would He reject you as a weed?

✅ 6. THE CHURCH IS FILLED WITH WEEDS—AND MANY DON’T EVEN KNOW IT!
Many Christians today refuse to believe that there are false believers, false preachers, and false gospels in the church. But Jesus warned us—not everyone who claims to follow Him actually belongs to Him!

📖 2 Timothy 3:5 (KJV)
"Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Some people LOOK holy—but they deny the power of God!
✔️ They sing worship songs, read the Bible, and pray—but they have NO true relationship with Jesus!
✔️ They are religious, but they are spiritually dead!
🚨 THE WARNING: There are weeds sitting next to you in church, preaching in pulpits, and leading ministries!
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly connected to Jesus—or are you just playing church?

✅ 7. THE DEVIL USES FALSE CHRISTIANS TO DESTROY THE CHURCH FROM WITHIN!
Jesus said the enemy PLANTED the weeds inside the field (church). Why? Because Satan knows he cannot destroy the church from the outside—so he corrupts it from within!

📖 Jude 1:4 (KJV)
"For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Some false Christians are not even aware that they are weeds!
✔️ Satan is using false teachers to spread lies inside the church!
✔️ Many churches today are filled with false doctrine because of these weeds!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you are following a watered-down gospel, you may have been deceived by Satan’s weeds!
💡 QUESTION: Are you being fed real biblical truth, or are you following a sugar-coated gospel?

✅ 8. THE TRUE WHEAT MUST ENDURE PERSECUTION FROM THE WEEDS!
Because the wheat and the weeds grow together, true believers will suffer persecution from false Christians.

📖 John 16:2 (KJV)
"They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Many "Christians" will attack true believers for standing on biblical truth!
✔️ They will mock, slander, and try to silence those who preach repentance!
✔️ Some of the worst persecution comes from WITHIN the church!
🚨 THE WARNING: If the world loves your version of Christianity, you are probably a weed!
💡 QUESTION: Are you standing on truth, even if it makes others hate you?

✅ 9. THE FINAL SEPARATION IS COMING—YOU CANNOT HIDE FOREVER!
For now, the wheat and weeds grow together. But on Judgment Day, Jesus will separate them FOREVER.

📖 Matthew 13:40-42 (KJV)
"As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world. The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity; And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Right now, you may look like a Christian—but Jesus will EXPOSE what you really are!
✔️ The weeds will not be "corrected" or "disciplined"—they will be BURNED!
✔️ There is no middle ground—you are either WHEAT or a WEED!
🚨 THE WARNING: You will NOT be able to fool God on Judgment Day!
💡 QUESTION: Will Jesus gather you into His Kingdom, or will you be thrown into the fire?

THE TERRIFYING FATE OF THE WEEDS ON JUDGMENT DAY!
Many people think they are saved because they attend church, give tithes, or do good works. But Jesus warned that on the Final Day, many will be SHOCKED to realize they were never truly His!

📖 Matthew 13:40-42 (KJV)
"As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world. The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity; And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ There will be no place for fake Christians in God's Kingdom!
✔️ All those who lived in rebellion will be THROWN into eternal fire!
✔️ Hell is not just for atheists—it is for every false believer who rejected obedience!
🚨 THE WARNING: Millions who thought they were "good Christians" will be horrified when they are cast out forever!
💡 QUESTION: If you died right now, would Jesus welcome you—or would He cast you away as a weed?

✅ 1. THE ANGELS WILL GATHER THE WEEDS AND THROW THEM INTO HELL!
Jesus made it clear: The separation of the wheat and weeds will be carried out by His holy angels!

📖 Matthew 13:49-50 (KJV)
"So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just, And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ No one will be able to hide—EVERY person will be examined!
✔️ If your name is not in the Book of Life, the angels will THROW YOU into hell!
✔️ There will be no time for excuses—no chance to plead your case!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you are not truly saved, angels will come for you—but NOT to bring you to Heaven!
💡 QUESTION: Are you truly saved, or are you one of those whom the angels will throw into the fire?

✅ 2. MANY WILL BE REJECTED—EVEN IF THEY DID RELIGIOUS WORKS!
Jesus warned that on Judgment Day, MANY will be SHOCKED when He tells them, "I NEVER KNEW YOU!"

📖 Matthew 7:22-23 (KJV)
"Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You can be "in ministry" and still go to hell!
✔️ You can cast out demons and still be rejected by Jesus!
✔️ The only thing that matters is OBEDIENCE and TRUE FAITH in Christ!
🚨 THE WARNING: Jesus will reject those who ONLY had religion—but never had a real relationship with Him!
💡 QUESTION: Does Jesus truly KNOW you—or do you just "use His name" without following Him?

✅ 3. THERE WILL BE NO SECOND CHANCES AFTER DEATH!
Once you die, your eternal fate is sealed forever. There is no such thing as "praying for the dead" or a "second chance."

📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV)
"And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Your choices in THIS life determine where you will spend eternity!
✔️ There are no do-overs—once you die, you will face God’s judgment!
✔️ If you are a weed at death, you will be thrown into the fire forever!
🚨 THE WARNING: If you are waiting to "get right with God later," you are already on the road to destruction!
💡 QUESTION: Are you playing with your eternity, or have you fully surrendered to Christ NOW?

✅ 4. HELL IS A REAL, ETERNAL PLACE OF UNIMAGINABLE TORMENT!
Many people today deny the reality of hell. But Jesus spoke about hell MORE THAN HEAVEN!

📖 Mark 9:43-44 (KJV)
"And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ Hell is NOT a temporary place—it is ETERNAL!
✔️ The suffering in hell NEVER ends—there is NO relief!
✔️ The fire will NEVER be quenched—every soul in hell will be in torment forever!
🚨 THE WARNING: If Jesus described hell with such urgency, why would you risk going there?
💡 QUESTION: Do you live like someone who fears God’s judgment—or are you ignoring the warnings?

✅ 5. ONLY THE WHEAT WILL BE TAKEN INTO GOD’S KINGDOM!
While the weeds are burned in the fire, the wheat (true believers) will be gathered into God’s Kingdom forever!

📖 Matthew 13:43 (KJV)
"Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ True believers will be separated and rewarded by Jesus!
✔️ There will be NO MORE pain, suffering, or deception—only GLORY!
✔️ The wheat will SHINE, while the weeds BURN!
🚨 THE WARNING: Your eternal future is being decided RIGHT NOW—wheat or weed? Heaven or hell?
💡 QUESTION: Will YOU shine in God’s Kingdom, or will you be cast into outer darkness?

THE FINAL WARNING – YOU CANNOT STAY NEUTRAL!
Jesus has made it clear: The wheat (true believers) will be gathered into His Kingdom, but the weeds (false Christians) will be cast into eternal fire.

🚨 THERE ARE ONLY TWO OPTIONS:
✔️ Repent, obey Jesus, and bear real fruit
❌ Ignore this message and face eternal judgment

📖 Galatians 6:7-8 (KJV)
"Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap. For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting."

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ If you live for yourself, you will reap DESTRUCTION!
✔️ If you live for Christ, you will reap ETERNAL LIFE!
✔️ You cannot fool God—your FRUIT will prove who you really are!
🚨 THE WARNING: Time is running out—JESUS IS COMING SOON!
💡 QUESTION: What will your life prove on Judgment Day?

🚨 JESUS WILL REJECT MANY WHO THOUGHT THEY WERE SAVED!
📖 Luke 13:24-27 (KJV)
"Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able. When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets. But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity."

🚨 THINK ABOUT THIS:
❌ These people THOUGHT they were saved—but Jesus SHUT THE DOOR on them!
❌ They knew ABOUT Jesus—but Jesus did not KNOW them!
❌ They wanted salvation—but they waited TOO LATE!

🔥 THIS MEANS:
✔️ You must truly belong to Jesus—not just be "around" Christianity!
✔️ You cannot wait until it’s too late—TODAY is the day of salvation!
✔️ There is no second chance after death—your decision is FINAL!
🚨 THE WARNING: Once the door is shut, it will NEVER open again!
💡 QUESTION: Will Jesus open the door for you, or will He say, "I never knew you"?

🔥 THIS MAY BE YOUR LAST WARNING!
The truth has been spoken. You cannot unread this or pretend you never heard it.

🚨 WHAT WILL YOU DO NOW?
❌ Ignore it and stay in deception?
✔️ Repent, obey Jesus, and truly become part of God’s family?

📖 Hebrews 3:15 (KJV)
"While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation."
🔥 THIS MAY BE YOUR LAST CHANCE TO CHOOSE!
